run.question:
You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: OpenTelemetry Demo Astronomy Shop
Namespace: astronomy-shop

An online shopping platform built with a microservices architecture, showcasing OpenTelemetry instrumentation for distributed tracing across services.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

report.summary: The checkout service in namespace astronomy-shop is down because its Deployment carries an unsatisfiable node selector. Deployment checkout has spec.template.spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"extra-node"}, but the cluster's four nodes carry hostname labels sregym-control-plane, sregym-worker, sregym-worker2 and sregym-worker3, so both checkout pods are Pending with PodScheduled=False, reason Unschedulable ('3 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector'), and repeated FailedScheduling events. The Deployment went to generation 2 with a new ReplicaSet at 03:16:12Z, the previously running checkout pod checkout-6c769b88b5-brrbx was killed at 03:16:12Z, and the checkout Service 10.96.50.45:8080 now has an Endpoints object with no subsets. Consequence, observed directly: frontend's client span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder fails with otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.50.45:8080', frontend POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500, frontend-proxy POST and 'router frontend egress' return 500 for the load-generator user_checkout_single journey, and the locust-fetcher reports HTTPError 500 for POST /api/checkout. All other astronomy-shop deployments read 1/1 ready at 03:16:41Z, only checkout targets hostname extra-node cluster-wide, flagd feature flags are all off by default, and no NetworkPolicy or ResourceQuota exists in the namespace, so no second active fault was found. Limitations: change_history is not integrated (only managedFieldsSummary is visible), application metrics/traces in this run start around 03:15:30Z, and the old checkout pod's logs are gone with the pod.

claims.text: Deployment checkout in namespace astronomy-shop has spec.template.spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"extra-node"}; no other astronomy-shop deployment sets any nodeSelector.

The cluster has four Ready nodes whose kubernetes.io/hostname labels are sregym-control-plane, sregym-worker, sregym-worker2 and sregym-worker3; no node named extra-node exists, and all four nodes were created at 2026-11-23T19:43-19:44Z (no node churn during the incident).

Both checkout pods (checkout-54579c864c-lvjvh, created 03:16:12Z, and checkout-c69887c97-ch7f4, created 03:16:18Z) are Pending with condition PodScheduled=False, reason Unschedulable, message '0/4 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 3 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector', and each pod's own spec.nodeSelector is kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node.

Event stream shows FailedScheduling for checkout-54579c864c-lvjvh at 2026-11-24T03:16:12Z and for checkout-c69887c97-ch7f4 at 2026-11-24T03:16:18Z with the identical 'didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector' message, while the previously running pod checkout-6c769b88b5-brrbx had started its checkout container at 03:15:54Z and was stopped ('Killing') at 03:16:12Z.

Deployment checkout is at generation 2 with condition Available=False, reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 2026-11-24T03:16:12Z; its managedFieldsSummary records a kubectl-client-side-apply Update at 03:16:12Z and an OpenAPI-Generator Update at 03:16:18Z, and the kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration copy of the pre-change template contains no nodeSelector.

The two new checkout ReplicaSets checkout-54579c864c and checkout-c69887c97 are owned by Deployment checkout, both use the unchanged image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.2.0-checkout, and both carry the nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node - i.e. a config-only template change, not an image change.
Service checkout has clusterIP 10.96.50.45 (port 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=checkout) and its Endpoints object has no subsets and no addresses, so the service has no backing pod.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="astronomy-shop",deployment="checkout"} read 0 at 2026-11-24T03:16:29Z, and the deployment table at 03:16:41Z shows checkout with no readyReplicas and no availableReplicas while every other astronomy-shop deployment shows ready=1 available=1.

frontend spans at 2026-11-24T03:16:25Z show the failure on the checkout path: span POST /api/checkout with http.status_code=500 and otel.status_code=ERROR, span 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' with http.status_code=500 plus exception.message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.50.45:8080 (2026-11-24T03:16:22.328Z)', and client span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=14.

In the same trace 56822763271edda6128a51637a64e119, the load-generator span POST returned error=true http.status_code=500, frontend-proxy spans POST and 'router frontend egress' returned error=true http.status_code=500, and the user journey span is load-generator user_checkout_single.

frontend pod frontend-6859c775df-n6nk2 logged 'Error: 14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.50.45:8080 (2026-11-24T03:16:22.328Z)' at 2026-11-24T03:16:25Z (earlier identical refusals at 03:15:44Z/03:15:48Z were before the checkout container started at 03:15:53Z).

The load generator's own statistics at 2026-11-24T03:16:28Z list 'errors': [{'error': "HTTPError('500 Server Error: Internal Server Error for url: /api/checkout')", 'method': 'POST', 'name': '/api/checkout', 'occurrences': 1}] with fail_ratio 0.047619 and num_failures 1 for POST /api/checkout.

Before the rollout the checkout service was serving: the spanmetric traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"} counter held the value 1 in its only sample at 2026-11-24T03:16:15Z (no error status recorded).

Other astronomy-shop components checked and found without their own failure signal: all deployments except checkout read availableReplicas=1 at 03:16:41Z, only checkout pods target hostname extra-node cluster-wide, the namespace contains no NetworkPolicy and no ResourceQuota objects, and non-checkout frontend spans in the same window returned http.status_code=200 for /api/cart, /api/data, /api/products/{productId} and ProductReviewService (rpc.grpc.status_code=0).

The flagd demo.flagd.json in ConfigMap flagd-config has every fault-injection flag (adFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, failedReadinessProbe, llmRateLimitError, llmInaccurateResponse, adHighCpu, adManualGc, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage) with defaultVariant 'off', so no feature-flag fault was in effect.

Rejected: that a node named extra-node failed or was deleted. All four nodes are Ready, were created at 2026-11-23T19:43-19:44Z and no node-deletion/NotReady events appear; the selector appeared with the checkout Deployment update at 03:16:12Z while the earlier checkout pod had scheduled on sregym-worker3 normally, and only the checkout Deployment in the whole cluster references extra-node.

The nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node was injected into the checkout Deployment as a deliberate fault (two template updates within six seconds, neither accompanied by an image change), not by the Helm release that created checkout at revision 1; the actor and intent cannot be confirmed because change history is not available.

Remove spec.template.spec.nodeSelector from Deployment checkout (or label an intended node with kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node) and let the rollout reschedule; verify pods become Ready, that the checkout Endpoints object regains addresses, and that frontend oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder stops returning gRPC 14 / HTTP 500.

gaps: change_history is not integrated in this Run, so who set the checkout nodeSelector and the exact field-level change at 03:16:12Z/03:16:18Z cannot be confirmed from managedFieldsSummary alone.

Application metrics and traces in this Run begin around 2026-11-24T03:15:30Z (the namespace was (re)deployed at 03:15:25Z), so no pre-incident baseline exists for error rate or latency comparison and no latency trend can be claimed.

Queries for a pre-rollout baseline of traces_span_metrics_calls_total returned no data (a2590c3e-f257-4508-86ca-ff4a9f445b6e-t1:9026a7bb-9d35-4d5f-a61d-e15663533cd3, db340077-c27b-4200-b6e1-dfef6ea70cb3-t0:a1826857-8e13-44ce-8211-8b82576077d9, 1821fa16-a07d-4234-bb3f-46517238b8ce-t1:1e5c0af7-a503-4995-90e8-6ec3c5ee4e2c), so the pre-incident span rate is unknown rather than zero.

Jaeger returned frontend spans only from 2026-11-24T03:16:14Z onward in the sampled view (the 03:11-03:16 search view 8127de18-6c2e-459d-9794-ab0aa9fd49e3-t0:027f58f9-65f8-4c58-8c5c-c84d25ea71ee is incomplete/truncated); requests before the 03:16:12Z rollout are not visible.

Pod checkout-6c769b88b5-brrbx no longer exists, so its application logs could not be read; a Loki query for pod=~"checkout-.*" with the error filter returned no data (2615b986-d655-41b7-80c6-87ebd7be0139-t1:22fc9598-e275-417f-85b8-eaab870d51e6), and a load-generator log filter also returned no data (9cbeec6c-f99b-4aab-948b-0c7449a2a2b4-t1:ecd8b301-f866-43aa-b05a-156acc17dc0a).

The kube_deployment_status_replicas_available sample at 2026-11-24T03:16:29Z also read 0 for accounting, fraud-detection and grafana; their pods were Running/Ready and their deployments 1/1 at 03:16:41Z, and the reason those single 0 readings occurred (likely pre-readiness samples) is not established.

Impact figures are bounded by the observation window: only one failed POST /api/checkout (occurrences 1, fail_ratio 0.047619) and one failed PlaceOrder span were observed before the authorized window ended at 03:16:29Z, so the full customer impact of the outage is unknown.
next_steps: Check whether the extra-node selector was applied by an automated fault injector or by a human kubectl apply, using cluster audit/change history outside this Run.
After remediation, re-check checkout pod scheduling, the checkout Endpoints addresses, and the spanmetric status_code for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind. When the API server returns zero objects of a kind other than events (every page read), the result is ok with total_items_processed 0: it proves only that there were no objects matching this kind, namespace and selectors at query time, not that none existed during the incident. Zero events, or a list your filter reduced to nothing, stays no_data. metadata.managedFieldsSummary gives each manager's last write time only: it is not a full change history (earlier writes by the same manager are gone) and it does not say which fields that write changed.
